Most patients with kidney disease present in clusters associated with acute kidney disease at baseline (severe kidney, myeloperoxidase, and proteinase 3-ANCA clusters). These clusters are associated with higher risks of kidney failure and death. The spectrum of extrarenal disease manifestations and inflammation at baseline is also variable. ANCA, Antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibody; CNS, central nervous system; CRP, C-reactive protein; ENT, ear, nose, and throat; KF, kidney failure; MPA, microscopic polyangiitis; MPO, myeloperoxidase; PNS, peripheral nervous system; PR3, proteinase 3.
